candidates.title: Better Days: A Hackathon — San Francisco
candidates.evidence:
Better Days: A Hackathon — San Francisco
Japan Town
San Francisco, CA
RSVP here: https://luma.com/clickh-sie8

​**VENUE IS 18+**

Want to be a judge? Apply here, open till August 18th: [https://forms.gle/mMP7PxkFbpQ6dZby8](https://forms.gle/mMP7PxkFbpQ6dZby8?utm_source=luma)

We're heading to Japantown for a full day of building, brought to you by ClickHouse! :)

One day. Real problems. Real prizes. Pick a track, form a team of up to 5 (or go solo), and build something using ClickHouse + Postgres — OLAP and OLTP, like PB&J. This is an AI hackathon grounded in problems that affect everyday people: kids who can't read, adults who are lonely, a planet people want to help but don't know how. Build something someone would actually open on a hard day.

Partner engineers will be at the expert bar all day to help you move fast. Breakfast, lunch, and drinks are on us. We close the night with demos, judging, and dinner together.

**Four tracks to build in**
​**The reading crisis**
Two-thirds of 4th graders read below grade level, and the kids furthest behind are falling fastest. Build the tool that helps a teacher spot who's quietly struggling, helps a student find the book they'll actually finish, or helps a library know what's working.
​**The loneliness epidemic**
Half of American adults are lonely, and it's worse for the young. Build for the communities trying to hold people together: senior centers, campus groups, neighborhoods.
​**Climate action that's actually usable**
People are worried and don't know what to do. Build the tool that replaces guilt with a clear next step, the rebate they didn't know existed, the local vote that actually cuts emissions, the neighborhood prep for the next heat wave. Not another carbon calculator.
​**Open track — your everyday crisis**
Got a problem that keeps you up at night that isn't on this list? Bring it. Food access, caregiving, housing, mental health, if real people are struggling with it and a well-built tool could help, you're in the right place.

**Prizes**:
🥇 Grand prize — 1k in Cash, ClickHouse Cloud credits $500
🥈 Runner-up — $500 in Cash, ClickHouse cloud credits $300
​⭐ Bonus category (Build with LibreChat) - $250 cash
​🎉 Social raffle - Physical Gift, TBD
​**Schedule**
9:30 am — Doors open + coffee
Check in, grab a drink, find your team
​10:00 am — Kickoff
Rules, tracks, and tools walkthrough
​10:15 am — Hacking begins
Expert bar open — ClickHouse engineers on-site all day
​5:00 pm — Submissions close
Lock in your build
​5:05 pm — Demos + presentations
Each team presents to judges, selected present to whole crowd
​6:00 pm — Dinner + awards
Cash prizes, credits, and glory

**​About [ClickHouse](https://clickhouse.com/?utm_source=luma)**
​ClickHouse is the open-source columnar database built for speed — the engine behind real-time analytics at massive scale. If you've ever needed answers from billions of rows in milliseconds, this is your tool.
​📚 Get started on [ClickHouse Github](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse?utm_source=luma)
​💬 Join the [ClickHouse Slack Channel](https://clickhouse.com/slack?utm_source=luma)
💜 We’re hiring, [join our team](https://clickhouse.com/company/careers?utm_source=luma)!

candidates.title: Veteran Innovation Hackathon
candidates.evidence:
Veteran Innovation Hackathon
Hacker Dojo
Mountain View, CA
A 3-day hackathon at Hacker Dojo bringing together **veterans, engineers, designers, nonprofit leaders, and community builders** to co-create solutions to challenges faced by the veteran community.
......................................................................................................

**THE CHALLENGE**
***What was the hardest part about coming home as a veteran?***
For many veterans, the challenge does not end when they leave the service. It begins when they try to navigate the systems designed to support them.
Too often, veterans face:

* Confusing websites and complicated processes
* Long application forms
* Unclear pathways to finding the right resources
* Waiting weeks or months for support when they need it most

***When a veteran needs help, accessing support should not feel like another battle.***

The goal of this hackathon is to explore solutions that make getting support as simple and accessible as possible. We believe veterans should be able to communicate what they need and quickly connect with the right resources, organizations, and people who can help.
......................................................................................................

***This hackathon is built around a simple principle:***
**Listen first, then build.**
Veterans will share their lived experiences, challenges, and ideas directly with builders. Engineers, designers, and innovators will then collaborate with veterans to transform those insights into working prototypes over the course of the weekend.
The goal is not just to create a project for a weekend. The goal is to build ideas that can continue growing into real tools, services, and solutions that improve the lives of veterans.
......................................................................................................
**3-DAY AGENDA**

**DAY 1 - LISTEN, PITCH, FORM TEAMS**
**Understanding the problem and finding opportunities**

* Veteran open mic sharing real challenges and lived experiences
* Innovation pitch session inspired by veteran stories
* Team formation and collaboration kickoff
* Evening kickoff into hackathon build begins

......................................................................................................

**DAY 1 - LISTEN, PITCH, FORM TEAMS**
***Turning ideas into solutions***

* Full-day collaborative building session
* Veterans actively engage with teams as advisors and co-designers
* Mentorship, iteration, and prototyping
* Evening continued development and refinement

......................................................................................................

**DAY 3 - DEMO & CELEBRATE**
***Showcasing solutions and creating momentum***

* Final build and project preparation
* XX:XX PM submission deadline
* XX:XX PM team demos begin (5-minute presentations per team)
* Judges deliberate and evaluate solutions
* Winner announcement and awards

......................................................................................................

Join us in bringing together veterans and innovators to build a future where accessing support is faster, easier, and centered around the people who need it most.

candidates.title: Hack and Race-Prep Autonomous Cars
candidates.evidence:
Hack and Race-Prep Autonomous Cars
UCSD, Engineering Building Unit 2
La Jolla, CA
San Diego Robotics DIYRobocars Race-Prep Day, Hosted by UCSD.

Please keep in mind that at the Saturdays meeting we expect you to have your robocar built and software installed. I hope you will understand that for us time at the track is limited to ever other week for 2 hours. We would like to use it for development as much as feasible.

Please complete your robot build before coming to the Saturdays meetup. See the 2nd Wednesday of month Beginner/Builder Meetup and our slack channel. Then bring your bot and computer to the track.

Please sign-up and come for our monthly Beginners and Builders Meetup before coming to the Saturdays Meetup.

Agenda:
10 :00 am - 1200 pm. Training and racing

We have built a double lane track with a yellow dashed center-line. Expect a track roughly 30x15 feet, with a concrete floor and duct tape lines.

Don't worry if you are still working things out with the software. We will be on hand to help all get going. This is a great chance to gather training data for you robot. Still figuring out hardware and/or configuring the software on the bot and laptop? Go to one of the 2nd Wed of month Beginner/Builder Meetups.

There will be tables, power, and wifi. Please bring your laptops and bot and be ready to hack.

A special thanks to UCSD for hosting us.

Thank you.
SD DIYRobocars.

***

Checkout http://www.donkeycar.com for the build information that many of us used to get started.

Checkout http://docs.donkeycar.com for parts lists, hardware and software setup instructions.

Self-steering car from SD group:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nxhsv5CViBg

more sample driving from San Diego meetup:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WecNKymdg3k

some sample driving from Oakland DIYRobocars meetup:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sQn5PA6nl3I
